title: Inside ‘Project Lily’: The Humans Reading Your ChatGPT Chats
excerpt: Humans are reading ChatGPT users’ prompts to improve OpenAI’s models, and those chats can include sensitive, personal information, according to leaked internal documents and real prompts seen by 404 Media.
